riskFactors: Mixing 'export const dynamic = force-static' with 'use client' is unusual in Next.js — force-static is a route segment config for Server Components; behavior on a Client Component page may be undefined.
The test added (fix-signup-page-smoke-500.test.ts, new test case) would fail on main as-is, meaning the orphan branch introduces a coupling: ship both changes together or the test fails.
Branch is 65+ days old with no PR created — suggests it was intentionally set aside.

riskReason: Changes are isolated to one page file and its test, but the force-static on a client component is an unconventional Next.js pattern that could cause unexpected build or runtime behavior. Companion test would fail on main without the page change.
recommendation: Human review required before promoting or deleting. Reviewer should: (1) confirm whether signup smoke failures are still occurring, (2) validate that export const dynamic = 'force-static' is valid/safe on a 'use client' page in Next.js 14+, (3) if valid and still needed — create a task to promote the fix; if superseded — safe to delete the branch.
